units.source_text: 向阿泷打招呼的这个人名叫阿清，外号黄瓜。

en.t: The woman who greeted Otaki was named Osei, and her nickname was Cucumber.

units.source_text: 她瘦削得像条黄瓜，脊背微弓，脸色苍白，常常卧病在床。

en.t: She was thin as a cucumber, with a slightly bent back and a pale face, and she was often confined to bed by illness.

units.source_text: 但她很喜欢孩子，要么给附近人家照拂婴儿，要么同三四个幼儿在公共温泉洗澡，只有逗弄孩子，才是她的乐趣。

en.t: But she loved children; she would either look after babies for nearby families or bathe with three or four small children in the public hot spring, and playing with children was her only pleasure.

units.source_text: 女人们曾同村里商定，不拉当地的男客。

en.t: The women had once agreed with the village that they would not take local men as customers.

units.source_text: 可是这条保证只有阿清一人严格遵守。

en.t: But Osei was the only one who strictly kept that promise.
Of course, she was from somewhere else.

units.source_text: 她想，既然是在这村子把身体搞坏的，就要死在这个村子里。

en.t: She thought that since she had ruined her health in this village, she ought to die in this village too.

units.source_text: 每逢她卧病在床，就幻想着她爱抚过的那些可爱的孩子，在她的灵柩后面排成长长的行列，为她送殡……

en.t: Whenever she lay sick in bed, she imagined the dear children she had cared for forming a long procession behind her coffin and seeing her off to the grave...
